Support for Rural and Small Town Water Supply Systems - Phase II

description.narrative: El objetivo del programa es aumentar el acceso a los servicios de agua potable y saneamiento en comunidades rurales y menores a 5.000 habitantes, priorizando aquellas de bajos ingresos.
The objective of this projecto is to increase water and sanitation access to rural communities and towns lower than 5.000 inhabitants, giving priority to people with lower incomes.
